test.status_at_freeze: never downloaded, inspected, featurised or used for tuning; single use; no replacement interval
test.download: uv run python scripts/fetch_navcam.py --split test --allow-test --workers 2 (only after this config is committed and tagged)

scheduler_v3.name: SCHEDULER_V3_STEREO_SAFE

tiers.COMPRESSED_STEREO_PAIR: L+R JPEG q50 — SIMULATED PRODUCT TIER
tiers.FULL_STEREO_PAIR: L+R primaries, NASA label estimate LINES×SAMPLES×INST_CMPRS_RATE/8

scheduler_v3.stereo_rule: a stereo acquisition is usable only when BOTH eyes are sent at COMPRESSED or better; a traverse stereo pair is broken if a kept stereo acquisition has no FULL_STEREO_PAIR cost
scheduler_v3.monotonicity: 0 decreases in acquisitions / scene clusters / rover positions / stereo present / stereo usable over numpy.geomspace(0.0001, 0.30, 80) × Σ FULL, and 0 single-eye usable stereo pairs

traverse.sequence_definition: same (sol, sequence_id), id starts with 'trav', ≥ 10 acquisitions with a PLACES position, ordered by UTC
traverse.positions: PLACES localized_interp landing_x / landing_y (site, drive, pose; nearest pose within site/drive)
traverse.POSITION: METADATA_POSITION: farthest-point sampling on Euclidean position distance from frame 0, k = ceil(fraction × frames)
traverse.POSITION_PLUS_EMBEDDING_CHANGE: farthest-point sampling on 0.5·D_pos/max + 0.5·D_emb/max (MobileNetV2 cosine distance), from frame 0
traverse.EVERY_NTH_FRAME: every round(1/fraction)-th frame from 0, truncated to k
traverse.UNIFORM_DISTANCE: nearest unused frame to k equal odometry targets
traverse.bytes: kept frames at FULL_STEREO_PAIR, the others at THUMBNAIL_PAIR; fraction of SEND_ALL (all frames at FULL)

embedding_preprocessing: features.to_work (256×256, fixed /4095) → Embedder mobilenetv2-12 (224×224 bicubic, ImageNet mean/std, L2-normalised 1280-d)

metrics: largest distance from any archived frame to nearest kept frame (worst sequence)
evaluation.bootstrap: paired resampling of traverse sequences, 95 % percentile interval

PASS_iff_all.P0: ≥ 3 qualifying traverse sequences AND ≥ 90 % of traverse frames with a PLACES position (otherwise FAIL: the claim cannot be demonstrated)
PASS_iff_all.P3: largest distance from any archived frame to its nearest kept frame ≤ 10 m in every qualifying sequence
PASS_iff_all.P5: Scheduler V3 monotonic and stereo-safe (see scheduler_v3.monotonicity)

primary.no_rescue: 1/2 and 1/8 are context only; no other operating point, metric or method may replace a failed primary

secondary.question: Does POSITION + EMBEDDING_CHANGE provide ≥ 0.020 absolute visual-change gain over POSITION at 1/4 retention without reducing 5 m coverage by more than 0.01?
secondary.MEANINGFUL ADDED VALUE: gain ≥ 0.020 AND 95 % lower bound > 0 AND coverage difference ≥ −0.01
secondary.HARMFUL: coverage difference < −0.01, OR gain ≤ −0.020 with 95 % upper bound < 0
secondary.role: does not affect the primary PASS/FAIL

diagnostics: pHash fields exist only because the observation schema requires them; no quality, pHash, telemetry or Jev signal is computed for ranking or used in any criterion
post_download_rule: after the first test image is downloaded nothing listed here may change; failures are reported, not fixed
